## Author checklist

- [ ] I own the cart's namespace (E19: the PR comes from the forge account the
      ID names, or `provenance` in the entry records the evidence)
- [ ] The licence named in `cart.toml` covers every file in the release
- [ ] Capabilities are declared honestly (`network` matches what the source
      actually includes — CI checks both directions)
- [ ] `jcx prepare` ran clean; the digests in the entry are untouched tool
      output, not hand-typed
- [ ] `jcx index . --write` ran, so the committed index matches the entries
